notes.title: Codename: Terranova 2.0
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the new version of [b]Codename: Terranova[/b].

What’s new:
[list]
[*] 60+ base modules 
[*] 10+ boss modules  
[*] 11 missions
[*] 10+ puzzles
[*] 50+ challenges
[*] 3 new game modes: custom play, campaign and quick play
[*] O.C.S.: More interaction and a completely new UI
[/list]
[b]…Everything randomly generated![/b]

Speed and precision are required to set a new record. 
Will you have the necessary concentration?

[previewyoutube=kshaEMLorgE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Are you ready? A new Update comes to Codename: Terranova
notes.content:
We've heard your feedback and we are here to release a new update. 
It contains:
[list]
[*] A revision of the first three levels for increased playability
[*] New game progression system based on the Agent's rank
[/list]
